n = int(input())
m = int(input())

# Convert n to base m and store digits in v
v = []
temp_n = n
while temp_n:
    v.append(temp_n % m)
    temp_n //= m
len_v = len(v)

# Initialize matrices
MOD = 10**9 + 7

def mat_product(a, b):
    size = len(a.data)
    c = MatrixNode(size)
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(size):
            for k in range(size):
                c.data[i][j] = (c.data[i][j] + a.data[i][k] * b.data[k][j]) % MOD
    return c

class MatrixNode:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.data = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]

# Initialize arrays
Nmat = [[MatrixNode(m+1) for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(len_v)]
S1 = [[MatrixNode(m+1) for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(len_v)]
S2 = [[MatrixNode(m+1) for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(len_v)]

# Build matrices
for i in range(len_v):
    if i == 0:
        for j in range(m):
            Nmat[i][j].data[m][m] = 1
            for a in range(m):
                if a != j:
                    Nmat[i][j].data[a][a] = 1
                else:
                    for b in range(m+1):
                        Nmat[i][j].data[a][b] = 1
    else:
        for j in range(m):
            if j == 0:
                Nmat[i][j] = S2[i-1][0]
            else:
                Nmat[i][j] = mat_product(S2[i-1][j], S1[i-1][j-1])
    S1[i][0] = Nmat[i][0]
    for j in range(1, m):
        S1[i][j] = mat_product(S1[i][j-1], Nmat[i][j])
    S2[i][m-1] = Nmat[i][m-1]
    for j in range(m-2, -1, -1):
        S2[i][j] = mat_product(Nmat[i][j], S2[i][j+1])

# Initialize matrix A
matA = MatrixNode(m+1)
for i in range(m+1):
    matA.data[0][i] = 1

j = 0
for i in range(len_v - 1, -1, -1):
    for _ in range(v[i]):
        matA = mat_product(matA, Nmat[i][j])
        j = (j + 1) % m

print(matA.data[0][m])
